title: Docs audit: "heartbeat" means two different things, and no doc says so

chat.text: doc/autonomy.md's "dynamic heartbeat" is a Claude Code session's own wakeup cron (now stopped). Servex/Heartbeat.js is a different mechanism that pings a task's silent owner agent and revives dead ones. A reader who knows one will wrongly assume they know the other. Judgment call for whoever owns doc/autonomy.md: rename one, or cross-link both. Full audit and the two stale-count fixes already applied: /framework/ai/2026-10-07/docs-vs-code-audit/report.md
